case.title: Wood build
case.request: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

messages: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

qualification.reason: Saved witness passes current machine gates; human task review remains pending.

reviewQuestions: Are materials grounded and quantities sufficient?
Are steps complete and captions faithful?
Does the final result follow from shown operations?

design.purpose: A raised outdoor herb planter for one person, giving 20 cm soil depth for three small herb plants; sizes are provisional until the photographed boards are measured.

steps.c: Lay the wide board flat for measuring and cutting
Measure the full board before marking any cuts
Cut 44, 44, 14 and 14 cm pieces, leaving offcut
Lay the second board flat for cutting
Cut the 44 cm base, leaving the spare length
Lay the base flat in its final position
Drill four drainage holes through the base
Stand the front side on the front base edge
Stand the back side on the back base edge
Fit the left end between front and back
Fit the right end between front and back
Drive two screws through front into left end
Drive two screws through front into right end
Drive two screws through back into left end
Drive two screws through back into right end
Drive two screws upward through base into front
Drive two screws upward through base into back
Drive two screws upward through base into left end
Drive two screws upward through base into right end
Sand all four outside faces smooth
Hold a level across the rim and check
